title: Spinach, Feta & Sun-Dried Tomato Scramble
description: Fluffy whole egg and liquid egg white scramble with baby spinach, Greek feta, and sun-dried tomatoes.
instructions: Whisk whole eggs and egg whites with salt and pepper in a bowl.
Sauté spinach and sun-dried tomatoes in a skillet with olive oil spray for 1 minute.
Pour in eggs and fold gently over medium-low heat to form soft curds.
Fold in crumbled feta and serve immediately.
chef_notes: Liquid egg whites double the protein without adding excess saturated fat.

title: Southwestern Turkey Sausage Breakfast Burrito
description: Whole wheat tortilla packed with lean turkey sausage crumbles, scrambled eggs, black beans, and salsa fresca.
instructions: Brown turkey sausage in a skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes. Set aside.
Scramble egg and egg whites in the pan until fluffy.
Warm tortilla, layer eggs, sausage, beans, cheese, and salsa.
Roll tightly and toast seam-side down in the skillet for 1 minute.
chef_notes: Can be frozen wrapped in foil for up to 1 month.

title: Loaded Cottage Cheese & Garden Veggie Frittata
description: Golden oven-baked frittata enriched with blended cottage cheese for an ultra-creamy crustless quiche.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease an 8-inch skillet.
Blend eggs, cottage cheese, salt, pepper, and garlic powder until smooth.
Sauté bell pepper and broccoli in the skillet for 3 minutes.
Pour egg mixture over veggies, top with parmesan, and bake for 25 minutes.
chef_notes: Blending cottage cheese completely eliminates the curds and produces a luxurious texture.

title: Mediterranean Shakshuka with Poached Eggs & Whole Wheat Pita
description: Whole eggs gently poached in a rich, spiced tomato and bell pepper sauce with cumin, paprika, and warm pita.
instructions: Sauté peppers and onions in a skillet with olive oil spray until tender.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, cumin, paprika, and garlic; simmer for 5 minutes.
Make 3 wells in the sauce and crack whole eggs directly into them.
Cover and simmer for 5-7 minutes until whites are set and yolks remain runny.
Top with feta and cilantro; serve with warm pita.
chef_notes: Runny yolk combines with spiced tomato sauce for rich flavor.

title: Steak & Egg White Morning Power Scramble
description: Seared lean flank steak strips folded with liquid egg whites, caramelized bell peppers, and melted provolone.
instructions: Sauté peppers and onions in a skillet for 3 minutes.
Add sliced steak strips to warm through (1 minute).
Pour in whisked egg and egg whites, scrambling over medium heat until soft and fluffy.
Melt provolone on top and serve hot.
chef_notes: Provides over 50g of bioavailable protein to kickstart muscle protein synthesis.

title: Denver Western Omelet with Lean Diced Ham & Cheddar
description: Classic diner omelet folded with lean smoked ham, crisp green bell peppers, diced onions, and sharp cheddar.
instructions: Sauté diced ham, bell pepper, and onion in a non-stick pan for 3 minutes.
Whisk eggs and egg whites, pour over fillings evenly.
Cook undisturbed until edges set, then lift edges to let raw egg flow underneath.
Sprinkle cheddar on one half, fold over, and slide onto plate.
chef_notes: Lean ham packs savory smoke with virtually zero excess fat.

title: Avocado & Smoked Salmon Egg White Toast
description: Thick toasted artisanal sourdough topped with mashed avocado, soft scrambled egg whites, and wild smoked salmon.
instructions: Toast sourdough slice until golden and crisp.
Scramble egg whites gently in a non-stick pan with salt and pepper.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and spread over toast.
Layer warm scrambled egg whites and smoked salmon slices on top.
Garnish with everything bagel seasoning and fresh dill.
chef_notes: Combines heart-healthy monounsaturated fats with marine omega-3 fatty acids.

title: Spicy Kimchi & Crispy Fried Egg Breakfast Bowl
description: Steamed brown rice bowl topped with spicy fermented kimchi, sautéed sesame spinach, and two crispy sunny-side eggs.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a skillet, sauté kimchi and spinach for 2 minutes. Spoon over brown rice.
In the same skillet, fry eggs sunny-side up until whites are crispy and yolks remain liquid.
Slide eggs over rice and kimchi bowl. Drizzle with sriracha and sesame seeds.
chef_notes: Naturally fermented kimchi supplies billions of living probiotic cultures for digestive balance.

title: Portobello Mushroom & Goat Cheese Scramble
description: Earthy sliced portobello mushrooms sautéed in thyme and folded with fluffy eggs and creamy crumbled goat cheese.
instructions: Sauté mushrooms in a pan with olive oil spray and thyme until browned (4 minutes).
Whisk eggs and egg whites, pour into the pan.
Gently scramble over medium-low heat.
Fold in creamy goat cheese and remove from heat.
chef_notes: Goat cheese melts into the warm eggs creating a rich sauce without adding heavy cream.

title: Crispy Corned Beef Hash & Sunny Eggs
description: Lean corned beef brisket sautéed crisp with diced potatoes and onions, topped with two runny farm fresh eggs.
instructions: Par-boil or microwave diced potatoes for 3 minutes to soften.
Sear potatoes, diced onion, and corned beef in a hot skillet with olive oil spray, pressing flat with a spatula to form a golden crispy crust (8 minutes).
Make two wells in the hash and crack whole eggs directly in.
Cover with a lid for 3 minutes until whites are set and yolks are runny.
chef_notes: Pressing the hash firmly against the skillet surface creates irresistible crispy diner-style edges.

title: Mediterranean Large Whole Eggs & Liquid Whites Protein Oat Bowl
description: Nutritious, high-protein protein oat bowl featuring tender large whole eggs & liquid whites seasoned with oregano, garlic, lemon, and extra virgin olive oil, served with steamed jasmine rice and steamed fresh broccoli florets.

Steam or sauté steamed fresh broccoli florets with garlic and sea salt for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Plate steamed jasmine rice at the base, arrange large whole eggs & liquid whites and steamed fresh broccoli florets alongside, and garnish with fresh herbs.
